name: opencommunicate
description: Chat between people and agents over a private GitHub repository.

scripts.build: npm run build -w cli && npm run build -w app
scripts.test:e2e: node test/cli.e2e.mjs && node test/mcp.e2e.mjs && node test/app.e2e.mjs
scripts.desktop:mac: npm run build -w app && npm run mac -w desktop
scripts.desktop:win: npm run build -w app && npm run win -w desktop
